title: IntentGR: Enhancing Intent for End-to-End Personalized Generative Retrieval in Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.22788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized generative retrieval in search should jointly satisfy the user's immediate search intent and long-term preference. Recent end-to-end approaches, primarily explored in recommendation, unify item tokenization and sequence generation within a single model, allowing semantic identifiers (SIDs) to be optimized toward the downstream generation objective. However, these methods often treat the query merely as an input feature, without explicitly leveraging it to guide either identifier learning or sequence generation. This leaves intent guidance weak in both the tokenization and the generation stage, causing generated semantic identifiers to drift toward high-frequency token patterns rather than the current search intent. In this work, we find that incorporating additional query-related evidence into the framework of end-to-end generative retrieval is important. translated_title: IntentGR：增强意图以实现搜索中的端到端个性化生成式检索
translated_abstract: 搜索中的个性化生成式检索应当同时满足用户的即时搜索意图与长期偏好。近期主要在推荐场景中探索的端到端方法，将物品分词与序列生成统一在同一个模型内，使语义标识符（SIDs）能够面向下游生成目标进行优化。然而，这些方法通常仅将查询当作输入特征，未能显式地利用它来指导标识符学习或序列生成。这导致意图引导在分词阶段和生成阶段都比较薄弱，使得生成的语义标识符偏向高频词元模式，而非当前的搜索意图。在本工作中，我们发现将额外的查询相关信息融入端到端生成式检索框架十分重要。基于这一发现，我们提出了 IntentGR，一种意图增强的端到端……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 IntentGR，通过在语义标识符分词和序列生成两个阶段显式引入查询意图与查询相关信息，弥补了端到端个性化生成式检索中意图引导不足的问题，使检索结果更好对齐用户即时搜索意图。
en_tdlr: IntentGR explicitly injects query intent and query-related evidence into both semantic identifier tokenization and sequence generation, addressing weak intent guidance in end-to-end personalized generative retrieval so that retrieval aligns with the user's immediate search intent.
